rule: P4 'Headings carry no terminal period' vs §6.1 'keep eyebrow/headline'
defect:
The rendered home

(hero line 107) is «כשהשמש יורדת,
הגינה נדלקת.» — heading_line2 ends with a period, both in index.json:23 and in the hero schema default (elmsnest-v2-hero.liquid:240). The spec keeps the headline but P4 bans terminal periods on headings; the two clauses conflict and the build followed §6.1.
fix: In theme/templates/index.json line 23 set "heading_line2": "הגינה נדלקת" (drop the trailing period). Do NOT change the hero schema default (line 240) — §10 limits the hero edit to the show_card setting; the template value overrides the default.
